title: The Roots of Your Profits - Dr Elaine Ingham, Soil Microbiologist, Founder of Soil Foodweb Inc
summary: Soil microbiologist Elaine Ingham speaks at the Oxford Real Farming Conference on how soil organisms cycle nutrients, unlock minerals from rock and air, and why pesticides and fertilizers harm soil life. Slides are linked in the description.
why: HN commenters cite her as the explanation for why soil biology, not added fertilizer, drives plant nutrition and farm results.

quote.text: Dr Elaine Ingham delivers a salient presentation.
